local_review.item: Every alternative rotation needs review by the grower and an adviser before anything is seeded (spec B11).
Market suitability is a table rule: confirm buyers, contracts, equipment and district/GSA rules locally.
Flooded field (winter flood / pre-seeding flood): flood fill depth and seepage water are not modelled (U); habitat value not scored
Pest note (Rice (medium grain, water-seeded)): weedy rice (U)
Pest note (Rice (medium grain, water-seeded)): rice water weevil (U)
Rice (medium grain, water-seeded): herbicide carryover to rotation crops (U)

Spec B1 shows only the wheat year (wheat Jan-May, bare Jul-Oct, drill wheat Nov-Dec). We model a 2-year cycle: year 1 rice then wheat drilled 1 Dec; year 2 wheat to 30 May, bare until the next rice flood. Confirm with the team.
